scenarios.name: fight-lifelink-gains-damage-dealt
scenarios.why: Target creature you control gets +0/+10 until end of turn, then fights the opponent's creature: each deals damage equal to its power to the other, and the lifelink fighter's damage gains its controller life equal to the damage dealt (2), not capped at the 1 deathtouch needs to destroy the Wurm. The +0/+10 keeps the Nighthawk alive through the Wurm's 6 damage.
